structure.opening_pattern: Opens on a number or a contrary one-liner; never opens with context or a greeting.
structure.body_pattern: Short declarative paragraphs, one concrete example per point.
structure.closing_pattern: Closes with an instruction the reader can do today.
structure.paragraph_style: One to two sentences per line, blank line between beats.

vocabulary.register: Plain practitioner language — eval, budget, POC, golden set; no hype adjectives.
vocabulary.verb_energy: Active verbs, present tense, second person.

energy.punctuation_style: Periods over exclamation; em-dash for the turn.

sentence_rhythm.variation: Short declaratives with an occasional long sentence for the turn.

signature_moves.move: Opens on a number or a contrary one-liner
signature_moves.evidence: Two of three samples open on a hard number.
Every sample uses an em-dash pivot after the opening claim.
All three samples end with an imperative.

do_list: Open on a number or a contrary one-liner; never open with context or a greeting.
Give one concrete example per claim.
Close with an instruction the reader can do today.
dont_list: Never use emoji or exclamation marks.
Never open with context or a greeting.
notes: Extracted from 3 samples; numbers-forward, no greetings.
